LanguageData.HiveLord_Quest_Title: Syndicate Contract: Beneath the Spore Shroud
LanguageData.HiveLord_Quest_Rewards: 10,000 silver, 1,000 hyperweave and one neurotrainer (Summon Hive Lord)
LanguageData.HiveLord_Quest_Description:
The Syndicate has detected unusual tremors near your colony: a Hive Lord is moving underground. They need a team to find it and kill it.

The nest lies in open arid shrubland near your colony. The Syndicate has confirmed an overland approach for your caravan. Accept the contract and they will mark the coordinates on your world map.

Deal with the five Spore Spewers on the surface first. Each has 1,200 health and a shell that only explosions can break. Their fog halves sight and ranged attack range across the map, reduces movement speed by 0.3 cells per second, and disables map search.

You have three minutes from the moment your caravan enters the nest. When time runs out, the Hive Lord will emerge. Clearing the spewers early will not bring it out sooner; any left standing will keep filling the battlefield with spores. The timer follows game speed and stops while paused.

Payment: {0}. Once the kill is confirmed, the Syndicate will drop the supplies near your team.

Withdrawing or losing every able fighter aborts the attempt. The contract remains open, but re-entry starts a fresh attempt. People and supplies left behind will not be recovered for you. After the kill, collect your payment and clear the site. The Syndicate will close the location once everyone has left.
LanguageData.HiveLord_Quest_NeedHome: You need a colony to receive this contract.
LanguageData.HiveLord_Quest_NoSite: The Syndicate has not yet found an operation site your caravan can reach. Nest coordinates cannot be confirmed.
LanguageData.HiveLord_Quest_CoordinatesBody: The spore-shrouded nest has been marked on the world map. The Syndicate repeats its warning: bring explosives. Once you enter, you have just three minutes to clear the spewers.
LanguageData.HiveLord_Quest_InterruptedBody: Your team has withdrawn, or no one remains able to fight. The Syndicate will keep the contract open.\n\nThis attempt's map will be removed. Re-entry restores all five Spore Spewers and the full three-minute preparation period. People and supplies left behind will not return with you.
